name: V-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Lift your legs and torso at the same time.
Reach your hands toward your feet.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A V-shaped core exercise where hands and feet meet at the top.
